scope: Performance-deterioration monitoring LEVEL 1-3, not communication failure L1/L2/L3.

interpretation_constraints: Monitoring level clearance is not itself permission to open positions.
The DD4% new-order stop also requires independent human approval and cannot be overridden by LEVEL 1 or LEVEL 2 improvements.
LEVEL 3 human approval is necessary but never sufficient to override other active stop reasons.
DD5% stop and liquidation-attempt conditions derive from prior Q11/Q12, not solely Q80.
Do not equate performance LEVEL 1/2/3 with communication failure L1/L2/L3.
Missing, stale, ambiguous or failed safety evidence defaults to new-order prohibition (Fail Closed).
